item.title: The Space Marine 2 Steam Workshop is open!
item.description:
​Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that the official Space Marine 2 Steam Workshop is now open! 

👉 Learn more right here

When playing with mods, you’ll be disconnected from the public matchmaking and placed in a private lobby. You can invite other players to your session using either an invite or a code. In a modded session, a watermark will be displayed at the top right corner of your screen.

Additionally, your game progression will be separated from the official game.

🖱️ Want to create a mod?

Certain conditions and restrictions apply, so make sure to read our modder's guidelines and the legal notice

When you have, you’ll find a complete guide explaining how to start modding!

item.title: The Confrontation Update is available now!
item.description:
Hello, Space Marines!

The Confrontation Update is now live for Space Marine 2, bringing Year 2 to an epic conclusion!

Patch 14.0 introduces two new PvP maps, a new Thousand Sons Terminus enemy, new Heroic weapons and armour pieces, plus the final Season Pass 2 cosmetic DLCs.

Watch the Confrontation Update Trailer below:

A BIG UPDATE FOR PvP ⚔️

Patch 14.0 expands Eternal War with two new PvP Arenas:

  • Sanctum on Avarax

  • Facility on Demerium

[carousel][/carousel]

The update also adds new weekly PvP rewards and Ordeals. Play Eternal War matches, complete Datavault challenges, and earn exclusive accolades and cosmetics.

PvE also gets deadlier with the arrival of a new Terminus enemy: the Thousand Sons Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer. Encounter this formidable foe in every Chaos Operation and throughout Siege mode.

NEW COSMETIC DLCs FOR SALAMANDERS AND RAPTORS
The Salamanders Champion Pack 2 🦎

It includes a new Heavy Champion skin and an exclusive Multi-Melta skin.

[carousel][/carousel]

The Raptors Cosmetic Pack 🐦‍⬛

It features five unique armour pieces inspired by the Chapter's iconic combat doctrine.

[carousel][/carousel]

Get it now!

Purge the xenos and heretics with the Space Marine 2 Confrontation Update, and don't forget to join the Space Marine 2 community.

THE EMPEROR PROTECTS

item.title: Mod Manager & New Launch Options
item.description:
Hey folks,

For those of you jumping into some Total War: WARHAMMER II today, you may notice a small update as we’ve just expanded our Mod Manager Early Access to include Warhammer II.

(Screenshot taken from original WH3 version)

From today, when you launch WH2 on Steam, you’ll now be given the option to play the game via the original launcher, via the Early Access Mod Manager, or by booting straight into the game. Our goal is to make playing Warhammer II with mods an easier, more streamlined process, so you can spend less time organising your mods and more time in the game!

You can read more on how the Mod Manager works in our original blog post from November 2025, as well as any improvements since then over in the Mod Manager forums. The forums are also the ideal palce to share your thoughts on the Mod Manager itself, both positive and negative, to help us make further improvements in the future.

Thanks, and enjoy!

— Steve, and the Total War Mod Manager Team
